export_policy: allowlist; no history, runtime, private evidence or corpus locations
sanitation: bounded maintainer-path and credential-marker scan passed on new/changed files
sanitation_reuse: First changed release-metadata and package build-number default inspection; accepted migration payload and vendor checks reused
lumen_source_gate: unchanged vendor evidence reused; pinned Settings.swift update uses its separate one-file receipt
limitation: Pattern inspection is not proof that arbitrary confidential text cannot exist
repository_policy: Single active public repository; private history is not imported or required
binary_reuse: Exact accepted signed, notarized and stapled build12 ZIP; no rebuild, re-sign or notarization repeat
source_metadata_note: Historical release snapshot; vendor comment/sample cleanup is documented separately and does not alter accepted binary identities.
